product_launches.description: Nanovate launched the beta of its AI dashboard for no-code Arabic chat agent deployment, combining language understanding, real-time speech/emotion AI, and workflow automation.

overview_description.description:
Nanovate is the leading Arabic-first AI automation company empowering MENA businesses to work faster, smarter, and in their own language.

From one unified platform, Nanovate enables companies to create AI voice and chat agents, automate workflows, and integrate seamlessly with their websites, WhatsApp, apps, and CRMs — all without a single line of code.

Built to support 22 Arabic dialects, Nanovate is bridging the linguistic gap in AI by delivering accessible automation tools for every business owner in the Arab world.

Our mission is simple: make every business in MENA more efficient and globally competitive through AI.
